reasoning: The claim is fully supported by historical records and news reports. In March 2016, Google DeepMind's AI program AlphaGo played a five-game Go match against 9-dan professional Lee Sedol, widely considered one of the top Go players in the world. AlphaGo won the series 4 games to 1. Prior to AlphaGo's breakthrough, AI experts and Go professionals broadly believed that an AI capable of defeating a world-class Go player was at least a decade away due to the vast complexity of the game.
